title: Accessories and spare parts | VOOL
description: Poles, cable holder, front panels, charge controller and measurement accessories for VOOL chargers and LMCs.

sections.title: Poles, panels and parts
sections.lead: Everything that goes around the charger. Order through your reseller.
sections.alt: VOOL Charger on a VOOL pole with cable holder

items.title: VOOL pole
items.text: For parking spaces without a wall.

items.title: Cable holder
items.text: A metal holder with a plastic insert that keeps the cable and plug off the ground.

items.title: Charge controller
items.text: The orange controller is the same in every VOOL charger. Sold separately as a spare or as the ISO 15118 upgrade.

items.title: MID metering
items.text: A certified meter for billing by the kWh, on the Commercial Pole and on the MID wall charger.

items.title: Chargers on a pole
items.text: One charger per pole, in black or wood, with the cable holder.

items.title: Current clamps
items.text: For measuring the main connection and sub-boards with VOOL LMC.

items.title: LMC Pro with 4G
items.text: For sites where no network cable reaches the switchboard.

sections.title: Need a part or a price?
sections.lead: Resellers have stock and prices. For projects, ask us for a quote.
